entities.summary: Algiers Jameal William Dillon Jr., nicknamed "Quadzilla", is an American professional football running back for the Carolina Panthers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Boston College Eagles, with whom he became the school's all-time rushing yards leader with 4,382 yards.
